chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 573: The Dice’s Checkmate & Gaozhijian’s Apotheosis
chapter_meta_description: The Dice’s gambit is revealed! Gaozhijian is possessed by the Zuowandao leader and uses the Great Liang Dragon Vein to challenge a Siming. Li Huowang watches in horror as the world changes.
og_title: The Changing of Heaven: A Stepson Claims the Mandate
og_description: Li Huowang’s victory turns to ash as his friend Gaozhijian, hijacked by The Dice, ascends on the Dragon Vein and declares war on Heaven itself.
twitter_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian 573: The Dice Wins
twitter_description: The ultimate Zuowandao trap is sprung. Gaozhijian is possessed, and the sky laughs. Li Huowang is powerless.

lore_anchors.definition: In this novel's context, the Mandate is a stolen fragment of divine power that holds up reality; it can only be supported by a family willing to commit self-slaughter, making it a curse as much as a blessing.
A high Daoist Siming deity, the Mother of the Big Dipper. In this novel, she is portrayed as a cosmic predator who seeks to create a Heart-Pan from powerful mortals.
The physical manifestation of a dynasty's accumulated power and ancestral sacrifice. It grants immense power but is also a chain, binding the ruler to the corpses of the past.
A spiritually potent being refined into a weapon or vessel for a Siming. Being a Heart-Pan means your identity is overwritten by a god's purpose.
